_about: The five game names (docs/handoff-2026-10-23.md section 16, Jon 24 Oct 2026). Display text only: the name is the game's title wherever a player meets it, with the hook under it. Ids, routes, kiosk names and cue ids keep their old names. The Act 6 deduction round has no name. Open content.

games.name: Granolia's Lightbulb Moment
games.hook: She knows how to turn on the lights. It's on the tip of her tongue.

games.name: In Duplicate
games.hook: Sir Irwin scattered his files. Match every copy. He bills by the pair.

games.name: Get Off My Lawn!
games.hook: Red means go. Green means freeze. Yes, backwards.

games.name: Boo's Catwalk
games.hook: When the music stops, strike a pose. She's always judging.

games.name: Sir Irwin Needs a Hand
games.hook: Three drawings open the door. He only has paws.
games.story: Sir Irwin wants into the bedroom. He's a dog, so a closed door is torture. The door only opens after three drawings, and he only has paws.
